briefdescription.para: Discrete-log Z/p adapter that represents non-zero residues by their exponent index relative to a generator.

detaileddescription.para: Holds two size-p tables: exp_table maps an index a to the residue g^a mod p and log_table is its inverse. Multiplication and division on indices become modulus_add / modulus_sub mod p - 1 with no table lookup, and inversion of a non-zero index a is p - 1 - a. Addition / subtraction first hop to residues via exp_table, do a modular add/sub, and hop back via log_table. negate shifts by (p - 1) / 2 (the index of -1). Used for small primes (2 <= p <= 32749 per interface/aring.h) via the SimpleARing CRTP layer.
